topics.topic: Study of stellar Twins reveal secrets of evolution and future of stars
topics.why_in_news: Astronomers studying stellar twins uncovered insights into stellar evolution, lifecycle patterns and the future behaviour of stars similar to the Sun.
prelims_quick_notes: Stellar twins are stars with nearly identical mass, temperature and composition.
Study helps understand lifecycle and evolution of stars.
Stars evolve through nuclear fusion processes.
Sun classified as a main-sequence star.
Stellar evolution depends mainly on mass and composition.
Fusion converts hydrogen into helium in stellar cores.
Astronomy research improves understanding of cosmic evolution.
Observations use spectroscopy and advanced telescopes.
important_facts: Stars generate energy through nuclear fusion.
Main-sequence stars spend most of lifecycle in stable fusion phase.
Sun expected to eventually become red giant.
White dwarfs represent final stage for Sun-like stars.
Spectroscopy used to study stellar composition.
Light-year is unit of astronomical distance.
key_highlights: Study compared nearly identical stars at different evolutionary stages.
Research improved understanding of solar evolution pathways.
Findings contribute to broader astrophysics research.
exam_relevance: Important for Science & Technology and Space Science.
Useful for astronomy and stellar evolution topics.
Can be linked with spectroscopy and observational astronomy.
prelims_traps: Stars produce energy through nuclear fusion, not fission.
White dwarf differs from neutron star.

topics.topic: India’s Power Transmission Network Crosses 5 Lakh Circuit Kilometres

prelims_quick_notes: Power transmission network carries electricity from generating stations to distribution systems.
Circuit kilometre measures transmission-line length.
Expansion supports national grid integration.
Transmission infrastructure crucial for renewable-energy transition.
Green Energy Corridors strengthen renewable evacuation capacity.
National Grid improves electricity reliability and balancing.
High-voltage transmission reduces transmission losses.
Power infrastructure essential for industrial and economic growth.
important_facts: India operates one of world’s largest synchronous electricity grids.
Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) major transmission utility.
HVDC transmission used for efficient long-distance power transfer.
Green Energy Corridor projects support renewable integration.
National Grid enables inter-regional power transfer.
Renewable energy variability requires strong transmission infrastructure.
key_highlights: Transmission network crossed 5 lakh circuit kilometres milestone.
Grid reliability and power accessibility improved.
Focus on modernisation and smart-grid technologies increased.
exam_relevance: Important for Science & Technology, Infrastructure and Energy.
Useful for power-sector and renewable-energy topics.
Can be linked with National Grid and green-energy transition.
prelims_traps: HVDC used for efficient long-distance transmission.
Green Energy Corridors linked with renewable-energy integration.

prelims_quick_notes: India liberalised space sector for private participation.
IN-SPACe acts as facilitator for private space ecosystem.
Space economy includes satellites, launch services and downstream applications.
Private start-ups increasingly active in launch and satellite technologies.
ISRO continues to play central role in India’s space programme.
Commercialisation linked with innovation and strategic capability.
Space sector important for communication, navigation and security.
Public-private partnership model expanding in space activities.
important_facts: IN-SPACe stands for Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Center.
NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) handles commercial activities of ISRO.
India’s space economy estimated around $8.4 billion.
Satellite applications include communication, weather and remote sensing.
key_highlights: Nearly 400 space start-ups active in ecosystem.
Private participation accelerated innovation and investment.
Commercial launch and satellite capabilities expanded.
Focus on global competitiveness and space economy growth.
Downstream services and data applications increased significantly.
